recommended_fronts.mission: Close GATE-01 by making LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 production-method-parity with NativeAgentRuntimeV2.
must_not: change the default backend in runtime.py
deliverables: Implement real plan_run in LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 using build_plan and ToolGatewayV2 semantic binding where appropriate.
Implement pause_run that stops/resumes graph thread and checkpoint state.
Implement resume_run that restores graph thread from checkpoint and continues execution.
Implement cancel_run that cleanly terminates graph execution and marks status cancelled.
Add parity tests comparing LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 and NativeAgentRuntimeV2 for create_run, plan_run, execute_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run, get_trace, list_runs.
Ensure all parity tests pass under AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph isolated shell and under default native backend.
recommended_fronts.success_criteria: GATE-01 moves from OPEN to PASS; 08F7 canary smoke tests still pass; native default unchanged.

recommended_fronts.mission: Close GATE-04 by exposing backend fallback metadata in dashboard status.
deliverables: Extend _agent_v2_snapshot in dashboard_routes.py to return backend_fallback_used and backend_fallback_reason.
Add dashboard smoke test asserting fallback reason is visible when fallback occurs.
Ensure dashboard status route remains read-only.
recommended_fronts.success_criteria: Dashboard /brain-dashboard/status exposes backend_fallback_reason and backend_fallback_used; no token leakage; smoke tests pass.

recommended_fronts.mission: Close GATE-08 by documenting and enforcing explicit cost/step/model-routing policy.
deliverables: Document per-step budget and max-step policy in governance.py or runtime config.
Add model-routing policy (PRIMARY_KIMI_MODEL, fallback model ordering, provider degradation rules).
Add smoke tests asserting budget/step limits are enforced for both native and LangGraph backends.
recommended_fronts.success_criteria: GATE-08 moves from PARTIAL to PASS; policy is visible in code/docs and enforced by smoke tests.

ordering_rationale: GATE-01 is the only hard blocker for default promotion, so R1 is mandatory before any default-promotion PR. R2 and R3 are also required for global default but can proceed in parallel after R1 is scoped; sequence shown reflects dependency on R1 for end-to-end parity confidence.
